resolution_notes: auth_type: other; ATS API uses a personal bearer token, not X-Api-Key or OAuth2 (https://docs.recruitee.com/reference/getting-started). free_tier_limits: 18-day trial limits confirmed (https://support.recruitee.com/en/articles/4065422-what-does-our-free-trial-entail). rate_limits: 1000/min/token (https://docs.recruitee.com/reference/getting-started). example: corrected to the documented bearer-authenticated company admin endpoint and representative response (https://docs.recruitee.com/reference/getting-started; https://apidocs.recruitee.com/).
